name: FAISS Semantic Chunk Compression Benchmark
description: Benchmarks efficiency and retrieval effectiveness of semantic chunk compression methods for FAISS-based vector search in retrieval-augmented generation systems.
evaluation_method: Retrieval effectiveness and efficiency metrics such as Recall@k, MRR, nDCG combined with latency, memory footprint and compression ratio
general_score_metric: Recall@k (primary for effectiveness) alongside latency/memory metrics for efficiency
reputation: Applied, practitioner-focused benchmark relevant to retrieval-augmented generation and FAISS users; not a broadly standardized academic benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on retrieval efficiency vs. effectiveness trade-offs; results are sensitive to index/hyperparameter choices and dataset preprocessing; not directly comparable to pure NLP benchmarks.
